P1.3-C.scope: CALLBACK is the only top-level transaction in scope; SOURCE, DISPATCH, and AU append are internal stages; MEASUREMENT, FINALIZE, and RESTART remain unresolved
P1.3-C.callback_owner_snapshot_semantics: every CALLBACK receipt carries committed before/after snapshots for all 12 owners, including unchanged owners
P1.3-C.owner_receipt_order_rule: fixed ASCII ascending owner_id order; order does not affect DSP stage or replacement order
P1.3-C.owner_receipt_input_validation: accept any input order, then require exactly 12 distinct known owner_id values and emit canonical ASCII order; reject missing, duplicate, or unknown IDs

typed_transaction_id.validation: nonempty, matching transaction_id minLength=1 in the GTC transactionReceipt schema

join_metadata.matching_rule: the same nonempty CallbackTransactionId and FrontendCallbackIndex bind the callback and all owner snapshots

coordinator.programme_status_and_fatal: owned by the fixed programme coordinator root
coordinator.retired_guard: programme status RETIRED blocks every public callback path; root machines have no independently callable public commit/abort/fatal success API

preflight_order: validate programme status and callback g against the committed main callback clock
validate nonempty CallbackTransactionId and matching callback_index for all present stage receipts
require owner snapshot set to contain each of the 12 owner_id values exactly once; reject missing, duplicate, or unknown IDs
validate all before_generation and before_sha256 values against the committed owner roots
validate all after generations and after_sha256 values against fully prepared staged roots; require unchanged owners to carry after equal to before
validate F01E and F03 provider lineages, plus all downstream owner receipts required by the selected callback
checked-compute all next owner generations and final top-level receipt fields before replacement
P1.3-C.commit_api: CallbackTransactionCoordinator::commit(&mut self, staged: CallbackTransactionStaged) -> Result<CallbackTransactionReceipt, CallbackTransactionError>; staged contains fixed named owner fields, never a generic root list
P1.3-C.success_semantics: one CALLBACK top-level commit consumes the complete staged transaction, atomically replaces all 12 owner snapshots, and emits one immutable receipt; no per-owner or per-source top-level success exists

replacement.precondition: all 12 owner checks, digest checks, lineage checks, and generation arithmetic finish before replacement begins
replacement.operation: move the fixed named after-states into the programme owner fields and assign precomputed generations
replacement.fallibility: replacement phase contains only infallible moves and scalar assignments; no callbacks, allocation, hashing, cloning, or fallible work
replacement.rollback: clone-and-rollback is forbidden; any preflight rejection leaves all 12 committed owner identities and generations unchanged

P1.3-C.abort_api: one callback-level abort consumes the CallbackTransactionStaged value; every owner receipt has after=before, changed=false, commit_count=0; no owner state or generation changes
P1.3-C.fatal_api: a stage fatal aborts the whole callback, records ABORTED plus the fatal receipt, sets programme status RETIRED, preserves all owner bytes/generations, and rejects subsequent calls
P1.3-C.preflight_rejection: result=REJECTED; no stage runs and programme status does not become RETIRED
P1.3-C.reader_eof_api_migration: ReaderEofMachine commit/abort/fatal and per-root success APIs become crate-private coordinator implementation details; no root can independently publish success
